notes: Verified 21-Aug-2026 by opening the live site directly. The site does not serve a working HTTPS version (https:// redirects back to http://) — use the http URL. The 'Exchange Rate' nav link resolves to /Home/rate_board, not a guessable slug; do not hard-code an assumed path without re-checking if this ever 404s.
requiresBrowserAutomationReason: CNY BUY/SELL values were confirmed present in the raw server-rendered HTML (fetched independently of a browser). A plain HTTP GET + HTML parser (e.g. cheerio) is sufficient for the primary path.
playwrightFallbackReason: If the site migrates to client-side rendering in the future, plain-fetch extraction will start failing validation (fails safe). Keep a Playwright-based adapter with the same selectors ready as a fallback rather than only building fetch+parse.
branchNotes: No branch/location selector was found on the public site; My Money Master publishes a single site-wide rate per currency.

primarySelector.description: Scrolling ticker on the homepage (also mirrored on /Home/rate_board). Each list item is one currency in a predictable plain-text format.

secondarySelector.description: Per-country card on the Exchange Rate page. Values are split into whole/decimal <span> pairs for a digit-flip visual effect — concatenate them. There is also a hidden hover tooltip (class flag-country-rating) with the same figures as plain 'Buy : X' / 'Sell : Y' text, useful as a cross-check.
secondarySelector.note: Use the ticker selector above as the primary target — it is plain text and does not require reassembling split digit spans.

waitStrategy.httpFetch: none required — values are present on initial response
waitStrategy.playwrightFallback: wait for '.rating-content.simply-scroll-list li' to be attached, then read textContent

validation.notes: Range is a sanity bound only, not a hard limit — widen per-currency ranges as real historical data accumulates. Reject a reading where BUY > SELL, or where the value looks like it's missing the /100 unit scaling (e.g. 0.60 instead of 60).

compliance.robotsTxt: not found (404) as of 21-Aug-2026 — no machine-readable crawl restriction in place
compliance.actionRequired: A human should read the Terms of Use page before this adapter is run on a continuous production schedule, per the project's compliance requirement.
